headline: HASSABIS STEPS BACK AT DEEPMIND
subhead: CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes the CEO job; Alphabet shed ~$190B intraday.
poster_story: Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind; CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes day-to-day control as SVP reporting to Sundar Pichai, while Hassabis becomes chair and Alphabet chief scientist and keeps Isomorphic Labs, and Alphabet shed roughly $190B of market capitalisation intraday
